svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Keelpay Support Copilot · Flow v2: how one ticket is handled
Fixed path, drawn in advance. Rules decide the route, models only write text, a person owns every outgoing reply. Target architecture.
Is the draft safe and good?
Set by design, not by model confidence.
It never comes from the text.
fields. It chooses no path and
Flags only, never blocks the route
Enough proof for a factual reply? Otherwise ask
the merchant, or write no draft at all.
Ledger: payments, payouts, fees, one merchant at a time
Knowledge base: product and API documentation
Compliance rules: approved and versioned policy
No tool writes. No send, refund or unfreeze exists here.
Policy blocks and Judge revisions share one counter:
2 at most. The same objection twice stops the loop.
LLM calls: 2 Judge off · 3 nominal · 7 worst case.
Remaining objections are shown to the Validator.
Each claim traced to its source
Same policy code, on final text.
One re-entry, then a person finishes
Approves, edits, sends back, or writes. Sees evidence and any
objections. Blocked drafts cannot be approved.
the person writes and sends: final gate still applies
merchant replies: same ticket_id, turn + 1, desk kept, previous turns loaded at node 5
Each desk is a fixed branch: same code path, with
its own prompt, tools and policy. The plan table
calls the tools, so fetching context needs no model.
No model picks a step, so every failure sits at a
known node with a known fallback.
HOW AN UNCLEAR TICKET IS HANDLED
Correct and enrich: typed fields marked as human,
Write and send: goes through node 14, direct-send
rate tracked so the copilot is not bypassed unseen.
Close: spam or thank-you, marked OTHER, logged.
One action, one owner: Head of Support triggers,
NAVY executes, Compliance joins sensitive incidents.
Levels: Judge off, drafting off, copilot off.
Copilot off leaves a manual queue that still works.
The switch is tested before launch.
Traces: latency, cost and errors for each node.
Evaluation: frozen set run on every change.
Learning: human corrections feed the evaluation set,
Isolation: Keelpay cloud only, no mixing of merchants.
Blue rule · Teal tool · Purple model · Orange person
L1 suggests · L2 drafts, a person approves every
reply · L3 acts on a scope, sampled · L4 acts alone
under a threshold. Higher means less supervision.
